remarks: Ultimate in sophisticated living! This upscale 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath end-unit townhouse with attached 2-car garage is a must-see. The gourmet kitchen features custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless-steel appliances, opening to bright, contemporary living and dining areas with sliders to a private balcony-ideal for unwinding or entertaining. The top-level primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, a private balcony, and a spa-like bath with glass-enclosed shower and jetted tub. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout, and a washer/dryer on the upper level adds everyday convenience. Step outside and enjoy vibrant downtown Stamford living-restaurants, shopping, and nightlife just moments from your door.
